title: Microsoft Purview: sync status for sensitivity label publishing policies
summary: Hold: the retry guidance omits that Microsoft's documented command retries failed distribution to Exchange Online locations, not every Microsoft 365 workload. The portal paths, command syntax and roadmap facts are supported, but the categorical claims of read-only behaviour and unchanged user and distribution behaviour go beyond the published description.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance guidance: After rollout; rendered controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Set-LabelPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -RetryDistribution is a valid sensitivity label policy retry command.
claims.quote: Set-LabelPolicy [-Identity] <PolicyIdParameter> -RetryDistribution

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Governance guidance: After rollout; rendered controls
claims.claim: The retry row and guidance present RetryDistribution as unqualified remediation for label publishing policy distribution across the feature's Microsoft 365 scope.
claims.quote: The RetryDistribution switch specifies whether to redistribute the policy to all Exchange Online locations. You don't need to specify a value with this switch. Locations whose initial distributions succeeded aren't included in the retry.
claims.fix: Keep the call, but change controls[1].governs to 'Retrying failed label publishing policy distribution to Exchange Online locations'. Add to its note: 'Locations whose initial distributions succeeded are excluded. Run only if necessary, for one policy at a time; this is not intended for every policy update.' Replace the first After rollout bullet with 'If a distribution retry to Exchange Online locations is necessary, run Set-LabelPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -RetryDistribution for one policy at a time; locations whose initial distributions succeeded are excluded.' These qualifications are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/set-labelpolicy#-retrydistribution.

claims.where: controls[1].note; rendered controls
claims.claim: RetryDistribution is its own Set-LabelPolicy parameter set.
claims.quote:
## Syntax
### RetryDistribution
Set-LabelPolicy [-Identity] <PolicyIdParameter> -RetryDistribution

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises allowing 24 hours for label and label-policy changes to propagate before troubleshooting recent changes.
claims.quote: For labels and label policy settings, allow 24 hours for the changes to propagate through the services. There are many external dependencies that each have their own timing cycles, so it's a good idea to wait this 24-hour time period before you spend time troubleshooting

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Changes dependent on new groups and group membership can take 24-48 hours.
claims.quote: But for configurations that depend on populating a new group and group membership changes, or network replication latency and bandwidth restrictions, these changes might take 24-48 hours.

claims.where: summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: The sync-status feature is categorically read-only.
claims.quote: Searched: "label publishing" "sync status" "read-only" "distribution" "users"; portal sync status retry query. Read whats-new and create-sensitivity-labels. Microsoft describes visibility but does not explicitly establish read-only behaviour or the absence of associated actions.
claims.fix: Replace 'It is a read-only view for admins; nothing needs configuring.' in the summary with 'Admins can use it to check policy distribution.' Replace 'The sync status is a view, not a setting: there is nothing to turn on.' in Governance controls with 'Microsoft describes sync status as visibility into when label policy updates are fully synced across Microsoft 365.'

claims.where: Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The change has no effect on end users.
claims.quote: Searched: "label publishing" "sync status" "read-only" "distribution" "users"; Purview sensitivity label publishing policy portal sync status query. Read whats-new and the roadmap description; they identify admins as the audience but do not state that end-user behaviour is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove 'It changes nothing for end users' from Why it matters and 'end users notice nothing' from the impact rationale. Keep the narrower supported statement that this is an administrator-facing status view.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: The change does not alter how policies are distributed.
claims.quote: Searched: "label publishing" "sync status" "read-only" "distribution" "users"; Purview sensitivity label publishing policy portal sync status query. Read whats-new, create-sensitivity-labels and the roadmap description; no passage states that the distribution mechanism is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove 'and nothing about how policies are distributed' from Why it matters. The sentence can instead read: 'The decision for a service owner is whether to build the status view into the label change process.'

claims.where: Scope: What it covers
claims.claim: Sensitivity label publishing policies publish labels and label settings to selected users and groups.
claims.quote: As part of the label policy, you select users and groups to have sensitivity labels and label policy settings.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the What's new entry describes sync status reading or displaying labelled content.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview sensitivity label publishing policy sync status view labeled content access automatic policy actions. Read the roadmap description and whats-new sync-status entry; both describe policy sync visibility, with no description of reading or displaying labelled content.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the What's new entry describes the sync-status feature taking actions on policies.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview sensitivity label publishing policy sync status view labeled content access automatic policy actions. Read the roadmap description and whats-new sync-status entry; neither describes this feature taking a policy action. General publishing and auto-labeling actions concern other controls.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: Purview sensitivity label publishing policy portal sync status values Pending Success column enable default retry distribution. Read whats-new, create-sensitivity-labels and missing-label troubleshooting; the latter explains PowerShell Success, not the portal's values.
